privateOwners.name: Fish frame and hover controls
privateOwners.notes: Constructor -> Fish; normalizeFrameOptions/setFrameOptions and normalizeHoverSettings/setHoverOptions own these values. Private keys include site.about.fish.frame.v1 and site.about.fish.rings.v1; ordinary audio response uses site.about.fish.v1. Read their normalizers/defaults before changing ranges. These are separate from the central Fish visibility fields.

privateOwners.name: Fish imported pictures
privateOwners.notes: createPictureLibrary owns local metadata at site.about.picture-library.v2 and original image blobs in the site-about-picture-assets-v1 IndexedDB database. Caption overrides and prepared display images differ from originals. A preference backup alone may not contain the image blobs.

privateOwners.name: Refs cabinet and layout options
privateOwners.notes: Constructor registration and createRefsControls own the detailed fields. The archive owner is about.refs.sketch; board.getOptions/apply and normalizeRefsOptions in snap-board.js define the content/validation boundary. The local fields list covers scale, width, height, placement, rotation, shoulder/opening/bay sizes, line weight and opacity. Original pictures have their own picture-source.js storage.

privateOwners.name: Skills panel and visual configuration
privateOwners.notes: mountSkillsSettings registers archive owner about.skills. The fields inventory groups Filaments, Color, Bursts, Particles, Cards and Structure/Frame; presets and the source read/apply bundle own additional settings. SkillsBaseline.mjs supplies the captured baseline. Central visibility preferences are not the complete panel configuration.

privateOwners.name: Oddio audio sessions
privateOwners.notes: sessionObject/unpackSession define editable sessions, currently format Oddio version 4, including sources/clips/lanes and session state. SAVE SESSION / OPEN SESSION in the accessible deck operate on this content. Physical panel preferences are mostly central schema fields; saving those is not an audio-session backup.

privateOwners.name: Notes editable drawings and library
privateOwners.notes: createDrawingLibrary, validateDrawing and parseDrawingFile own editable content. Current databases are site.about.notes.library and site.about.notes.working. Editable format notes-drawing differs from a raster export and from shared preferences. Preserve document/layer/anchor data when changing formats.

privateOwners.name: Sticky-note drafts and published bundles
privateOwners.notes: General Constructor -> Sticky notes is the authoring entry. Shared index/data modules separate drafts, bundle validation and visitor read history; published content is assets/annotations/sticky-notes.json. Import/export the actual note bundle and preserve scene anchors rather than treating it as an ordinary scalar preference.

privateOwners.name: Docs collection and uploaded originals
privateOwners.notes: Constructor -> Docs uses browser draft docs-library-draft-v1, Save document, Save to project and metadata JSON transfer. documents.json is the project manifest; original files and generated covers/pages are separate assets. validateLibrary in library/schema.js governs allowed content. Back up the referenced files as well as the manifest.
